title: Static SPA serving has no Cache-Control for hashed assets and no compression
evidence: Suspected (code reading in the task 4 review, not measured): STATIC_DIR is served with http.FileServer behind noListing; no Cache-Control header is set, so the content-hashed files in /assets/ are revalidated instead of cached as immutable, and responses are not gzip/brotli compressed. No load test or Lighthouse run was done.
impact: Slower repeat and first loads over slow networks; negligible for a local assessment demo with one small bundle.
precautions: Measure first. If needed, add Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable only for /assets/*, keep index.html no-cache, and prefer precompressed files or a reverse proxy over a third-party module (standard library only).
